Name: Ebiasaph, Son of Elkanah
Summary: Son of Elkanah and father of Assir in the Kohathite line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:23: Son of Elkanah and father of Assir in the Kohathite line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ebiasaph stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
